summary: Stage 4 Outcome tab UI tested end-to-end for Owner and confirmed Sales/Crew hide behavior. All 8 owner-facing flows (panel render, badges, History dialog, Rebuild, Correct fact for Final billed amount + As-found note, Re-point to Alternate then restore, Exclude/Re-include from learning) pass; version bumped v1 -> v6 and demo job was restored (Committed scope, included in learning) at end. Sales and Crew do NOT see the Outcome tab (0 tab count each). Mobile viewport 390x844 renders Outcome tab with zero horizontal overflow. BLOCKER for Quality UI redaction test: role-switch-select does NOT expose 'Quality view' as an option (only Owner/Sales/Crew/Marketing), so the Quality redaction of $ amounts, 'Dollar variance' hide, correct-fact field allowlist, and repoint-dialog no-dollar checks could NOT be exercised via UI. Frontend source (JobOutcomePanel.jsx L33 ownerOnly + L126/L211 redacted->'hidden') is coded correctly and backend Quality redaction is verified by pytest.

Blocks all Quality-side UI verification requested for Stage 4 (redacted amount cell, no Dollar variance line, Correct-fact field omits Final billed, Re-point dialog hides $ amounts).
